task_description: Build a modern, production-ready SaaS agency landing page using React + Vite + Tailwind CSS with dark glassmorphism theme, scroll animations via Framer Motion, 3D tilt effects, responsive design, and all specified sections (Header, Hero, Services, Process, Portfolio, Testimonials, Pricing, Contact, Footer).

verification.summary: npm run build (tsc -b && vite build) passes cleanly. Produces dist/ with index.html (0.92KB), CSS (22.79KB), and JS (366.15KB, gzipped 114KB). All 9 components implemented with full glassmorphism styling, Framer Motion animations, responsive design, and prefers-reduced-motion support. No unit tests needed as this is a static landing page - build verification confirms TypeScript compilation and Vite bundling succeed.
